name: Bakery Serving Tongs
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
description: A continuous stainless spring joins cherry grips with brass pins and broad evergreen pastry cups. The spring bend and both soft tips rest directly on the bakery pickup tray.
summary: Reusable softly rounded pastry tongs with three bearing areas on a display tray.
creation_method: Original metre-scale lofts, rounded cross-sections, integral spring return and separately editable grip pins. The artist scene renders the gallery thumbnail.

dimensions.axis_order: glTF X Y Z in metres
dimensions.origin: On the tray plane between the spring return and gripping ends. Long axis +X, customer view +Z.

rights: Original owner-project geometry, materials and renders. Owner-project reuse is authorized. Public download and redistribution terms are unspecified.
accuracy_notes: The modeled pastry utensil has a fixed open pose and rounded food-facing surfaces.

attribution.credit: Original Blender geometry, PBR materials and studio render authored for the Blender-3D-Gallery project.
